report:
The evidence does not support the assumption that ginkgo relieves tinnitus—current best evidence points the other way.

**What the research actually shows:**

- The most rigorous evidence, a 2022 **Cochrane systematic review**, concluded there is "no evidence to suggest that Ginkgo biloba has an effect on tinnitus when compared to placebo," and rated confidence in the (limited) trial data as very low (https://www.cochranelibrary.com/cdsr/doi/10.1002/14651858.CD013514.pub2/full).
- A large, well-designed **randomized placebo-controlled double-blind trial combined with a meta-analysis of prior trials** similarly found that ginkgo did not benefit tinnitus patients (referenced in https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/articles/ginkgo-biloba-in-the-treatment-of-tinnitus-an-updated-literature-review.html).
- An earlier **systematic review in PMC** was more equivocal, noting a few small older trials (e.g., Rejali et al., using EGb 761) reported modest benefit, but flagged serious methodological weaknesses (small samples, inconsistent dosing/formulations) limiting confidence in those positive findings (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3157487/).
- Reflecting this overall evidence base, the **American Academy of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery's 2014 Clinical Practice Guideline on Tinnitus** explicitly recommends *against* using ginkgo biloba or other dietary supplements for treating persistent, bothersome tinnitus, based on moderate-quality aggregate evidence of no benefit (https://www.entnet.org/quality-practice/quality-products/clinical-practice-guidelines/tinnitus/).

**Conclusion:** Contrary to the premise that ginkgo relieves tinnitus, the weight of high-quality evidence—including a Cochrane review, large RCTs, and formal clinical guidelines—finds no consistent benefit over placebo. Some small, older, methodologically weak studies suggested modest improvement, which may explain the popular belief in ginkgo's effectiveness, but these findings have not held up under rigorous testing. Current expert consensus advises against relying on ginkgo biloba for tinnitus relief.
